_help: Edit this file then run `pio run -t uploadfs` to push it to the device. Once on-device, in-app changes update both NVS and this file. Fields you don't want to override can be removed.
_filterCont: Spotter-continent filter for the DX list. "any" or "my" - "my" shows only spots whose spotter (DE) is on the same continent as your callsign.
_tileHideMask: Bitmask of launcher tiles to hide. Bit 0=DX, 1=Prop, 2=Beacons, 3=POTA, 4=Alerts, 5=Bearing, 6=Sp.Wx, 7=Contests, 8=Grayline, 9=Satellites. Settings always visible.
